subject: Acceptance gates & close timeline for prompt-pack + testcase delivery
messages:
From: Nadia Kline <nadia.k@brightcart.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eliot Shaw <eliot.shaw@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Prompt pack & testcases — delivery + acceptance window

Marcus —

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood's sandbox options this morning. As discussed, BrightCart is ready to provide our initial prompt pack and a 3k-case test suite so your team can run QA and the automated acceptance runs. We've attached the first drop and a working MAP draft.

Quick ask: can Redwood confirm the acceptance gates and the close timeline so we can lock procurement and sign the SOW by the end of next week? Our procurement lead needs an expiration and takedown schedule for the test material.

Attachment (zip): BrightCart_Testcases_v1.zip (contains CSVs, sample generations; 29MB)
Attachment (docx): MAP_BrightCart_v3.docx (mutual action plan draft)

Baseline constraints from our side:
- Ephemeral access only — sandbox tokens, no model weights or model export.
- Retention: test artifacts should be purged or returned within 45 days of delivery unless a separate data custody addendum is signed.
- No redistribution or public posting of testcases; BrightCart requires a one-time attestation at takedown.

Please confirm the following by EOD: estimated delivery window for a Redwood-provisioned sandbox, acceptance SLA (days to run acceptance), and what evidence Redwood will provide on deletion.

—Nadia
Nadia Kline
Director, Partnerships — BrightCart
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Nadia Kline <nadia.k@brightcart.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prompt pack & testcases — delivery + acceptance window

Nadia —

Thanks for the materials and the MAP draft. We've pulled the files into a staging bucket and kicked off a lightweight intake check. High-level confirmation up front: Redwood can meet the ephemeral-access requirement and provide deletion certificates; we just need to align on the acceptance gating script (unit-level pass rates + regression checks).

Proposed acceptance and close timeline (high level):
- Day 0 (today): BrightCart deposits artifacts; Redwood acknowledges receipt and posts sandbox credentials.
- Day 1–3: Redwood runs smoke ingestion and schema validation (internal).
- Day 4–8: Redwood runs automated acceptance suite (stability + quality thresholds).
- Day 9–10: Joint review and sign-off window (BrightCart runs sample verification in the sandbox).
- Day 11: If accepted, Redwood issues deletion certificate for non-approved artifacts and transitions allowed ephemeral logs to archive per MAP.

Notes/asks:
1) Please confirm which fields in the CSVs are PII so we can scope masking.
2) We will enforce a 30-day retention default on sandbox logs unless you request extended retention in the MAP.
3) Can procurement accept a conditional takedown attestation instead of a separate security addendum to avoid delaying SOW signature?

I'll loop in Olga (security/compliance) and Karthik (solutions) to nail the gating script and the certificate template.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nadia Kline <nadia.k@brightcart.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prompt pack & testcases — delivery + acceptance window

Folks —

Quick note from Security: we reviewed the sample manifest (promptpack_sample_manifest.csv) and a few items to flag before we hand off sandbox creds:
- Masking: we need BrightCart to mark any customer_id, email, or payment_token fields as sensitive. If they are present, we'll apply tokenization and create a pseudonym map kept only in the secure audit log.
- Access: sandbox tokens will be scoped to ingestion+query only; no outbound network egress to external storage endpoints will be permitted.
- Audit trail: Redwood will retain an access and execution log for 30 days by default. If BrightCart requires 45 days, we can extend but it will add to the cost line in the MAP.

For the acceptance gates, propose the following measurable checks to add to the MAP:
- Ingestion pass (no missing mandatory fields)
- Schema conformity (rows parse to expected types)
- Regression delta (no >1.5% drop in sample accuracy vs baseline)
- Latency threshold (p95 inference under 350ms for the target sequence lengths)

I'll attach a deletion certificate template and a short checklist. If Nadia confirms the sensitive fields, we can provision creds tomorrow.

Attachment (csv): promptpack_sample_manifest.csv (manifest of included prompt/testcase schemas)
Attachment (pdf): deletion_certificate_template.pdf (1 page attestation)

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
From: Nadia Kline <nadia.k@brightcart.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prompt pack & testcases — delivery + acceptance window

Thanks —

Confirmed sensitive fields: customer_email, customer_id, order_ref, payment_token. BrightCart is OK with pseudonymization for the test run but requests the full pseudonym map be shared under an encrypted file to our security contact only for audit purposes; not to be stored in Redwood logs. Also, BrightCart can accept a 30-day log retention but requests a guaranteed deletion certificate within 5 business days of takedown.

We also prefer the joint review to be 3 business days (Day 9–11 above) so our QA can run 2 full cycles. Can you confirm cost delta for 45-day retention vs 30-day? Procurement needs a line item.

—Nadia
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Nadia Kline <nadia.k@brightcart.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 May 2027 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Prompt pack & testcases — delivery + acceptance window

Nadia —

Thanks for the confirmations. Finalized items from Redwood side:
- Sandbox creds scheduled to be posted tomorrow (Day 0 ack already done).
- Acceptance gates we will implement exactly as Olga outlined; joint review window set to Days 9–11 to accommodate two QA cycles.
- Retention: 30-day default on logs. 45-day retention is available for an additional one-time fee of $2,250 (covers secure storage + extended audit retention). We will add that line to the MAP_BrightCart_v3.docx and highlight it for procurement.
- Deletion: Redwood will provide a signed deletion certificate within 5 business days post-takedown (template attached; we'll populate after cert).

Next steps (action owners):
- BrightCart: send final confirmation of sensitive fields (Nadia) — due EOD tomorrow.
- Redwood Security: provision sandbox and attach deletion certificate template (Olga) — in progress.
- Redwood Solutions: add acceptance-run schedule and cost line to MAP (Karthik) — will update and re-upload.

If everyone agrees, we'll treat acceptance as complete once BrightCart replies with final verification and we mutually sign the MAP. That will let procurement close the SOW.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
